blocks.text: Field Observations
ALPHA OBSERVATORY counted 73 meteors.
The observers recorded clear evening skies.
Each measurement was entered in the ledger.
The annual report preserves these findings.
BRAVO ORCHARD harvested 9100 kilograms.
The gardeners weighed the complete harvest.
Each delivery was entered in the ledger.
The annual report preserves these findings.
CHARLIE HARBOR opened 52 berths.
The harbor team inspected every mooring.
Each inspection was entered in the ledger.
The annual report preserves these findings.
DELTA LIBRARY catalogued 281 books.
The librarians checked every accession.
Each accession was entered in the ledger.
The annual report preserves these findings.
